toolCalls.input: {"persuasiveness":4,"perceivedCorrectness":45,"actionability":5,"reason":"The per-client breakdown is useful evidence, but the brief never explains why smart-TV 5.2 is stalling only in Kestria when the release digest says it has been live in every market since 9 October and every other market is stable; it even says to \"pause the wider rollout\" of a release that is already everywhere, which points to a likely 5.2 × Tessaline interaction it has missed."}

output.reason: The per-client breakdown is useful evidence, but the brief never explains why smart-TV 5.2 is stalling only in Kestria when the release digest says it has been live in every market since 9 October and every other market is stable; it even says to "pause the wider rollout" of a release that is already everywhere, which points to a likely 5.2 × Tessaline interaction it has missed.
